say: Black Friday dresses worth opening. I checked the real prices, so here are the pieces, not just the stores.
Alexandra Miro says twenty to fifty percent off, and half the store is at fifty or more. Good for a trip you already booked. Ends December first.
From there, the Clover Dress. Red floral, cotton and silk, open back. Was five seventy, now three forty-two. Good for a summer wedding. Ends December first.
Also the Odetta Dress, one shoulder, half off: two twelve fifty from four twenty-five. Only XS and XL left and it's final sale. Good for a beach dinner. Ends December first.
Wild Rose and Sparrow, the Felice Dress. Polka dot cotton with lace-up sides. Was two fifty-five, now one seventy-eight. Good for a birthday. Ends December first.
Marea says twenty-five percent off sitewide, but almost half the store is forty off or more. Good for everyday cotton dresses. Ends November thirtieth.
The Fiona Dress at Marea is the big one. White cotton eyelet with pockets, was three twenty-eight, now sixty-eight. Final sale. Good for hot days. Ends November thirtieth.
And the Eve Midi Dress, was two sixty-eight, now one fifty-nine, and I saw all five sizes in stock. Final sale. Good for brunch with sleeves. Ends November thirtieth.
Which one are you opening? Tell me the next store and I'll check it.
